name: mdx-human-edge-contract
ui_rule: A UI control belongs only when it supports intent, judgment, ratification, exception handling, bounded authority, intervention, or evidence inspection.
write_gate: Any write control requires auth session, policy, receipt, threat, and human-edge checks.
rules: humans stay at the edge rather than inside routine operations
the system runs loops and presents evidence before asking for judgment
manual operations require an explicit exception or ratification reason
